name: overte-mcp-bridge.js
description: WebSocket bridge client. Connects to the MCP backend for live entity spawn/inject. Required for live operations.

name: dance-script.js
description: Skeletal dance animation for model entities with armatures. Bobs, spins, swings arms, tilts head, and sways hips using joint rotations.

name: spin.js
description: Simple continuous spin animation. Attaches to any entity and rotates it along the Y axis at configurable speed (default 45 deg/s).
